  have htRatio : Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => LSeries (oddPart (sourceCoeff lam)) (σ : ℂ) /

  have hnear : ∀ᶠ σ : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 1, |sourceEvenLogarithm lam σ-ell|<1 := by
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp ht) 1 (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨u,hu,hub⟩ := mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.mp hnear
  refine ⟨Real.exp (-ell),2*Real.exp (-ell)*K,min eta (u-1),Real.exp_pos _,

  have h := Complex.locally_lipschitz_exp (r := 1) (by norm_num) le_rfl

/-!
# Finite Gram matrices realized by smooth Weil tests

Narrow packets centred at logarithms of integers realize every finite positive
semidefinite Gram matrix. At rational logarithms, integer log separation removes
all terms except the exact multiplicative diagonal. Thus finitely many matrix
identities certify cancellation at every integer logarithm.
-/

open Complex MeasureTheory Zeta23
open scoped BigOperators ComplexConjugate ContDiff ComplexOrder MatrixOrder
  Matrix.Norms.L2Operator

noncomputable section

namespace RHTower.WeilWorkPBAP

open WeilOneSided

/-- The positive integer labels through `N`. -/
abbrev PacketIndex (N : ℕ) := ↥(Finset.Icc 1 N)

/-- Squared mass of the common packet at denominator resolution `L`. -/
def packetMass (N L : ℕ) : ℝ := ∫ t, (narrowBump (N * L) t) ^ 2

theorem packetMass_pos (N L : ℕ) : 0 < packetMass N L :=
  integral_narrowBump_sq_pos _

/-- A finite combination of smooth packets at logarithmic centres. -/
def gramPacket (N L : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℂ) (u : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, c m * narrowBumpC (N * L) (u - resPt N m)

theorem contDiff_gramPacket (N L : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℂ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (gramPacket N L c) := by
  exact ContDiff.sum fun _ _ => contDiff_const.mul
    ((contDiff_narrowBumpC _).comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const))

theorem hasCompactSupport_gramPacket (N L : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℂ) :
    HasCompactSupport (gramPacket N L c) := by
  have h := HasCompactSupport.finset_sum (s := Finset.Icc 1 N)
    (f := fun m u => c m * narrowBumpC (N * L) (u - resPt N m))
    (fun m _ => ((hasCompactSupport_narrowBumpC _).comp_homeomorph
      (Homeomorph.subRight (resPt N m))).mul_left)
  have heq : (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      fun u => c m * narrowBumpC (N * L) (u - resPt N m)) = gramPacket N L c := by
    funext u
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, gramPacket]
  rwa [heq] at h

/-- The packet combination as an admissible full Weil test. -/
def gramPacketFn (N L : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℂ) : WeilTestFn :=
  ⟨gramPacket N L c, (contDiff_gramPacket N L c).of_le (by norm_cast),
    hasCompactSupport_gramPacket N L c⟩

private theorem packet_autocorrelation_zero (M : ℕ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : 1 / ((M : ℝ) + 1) ≤ |y|) :
    EF.weilTest (narrowBumpC M) (narrowBumpC M) y = 0 := by
  apply weilTest_self_eq_zero (fun _ h => narrowBumpC_eq_zero M h)
  have hpos : 0 < 1 / ((M : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have hhalf : 2 * (1 / (4 * ((M : ℝ) + 1))) =
      (1 / ((M : ℝ) + 1)) / 2 := by field_simp; ring
  rw [hhalf]
  linarith

private theorem rational_sample_shift (N a b m k : ℕ)
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    Real.log a - Real.log b - resPt N m + resPt N k =
      Real.log (a * k : ℕ) - Real.log (b * m : ℕ) := by
  have hlog (p q : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
      Real.log (p * q : ℕ) = Real.log p + Real.log q := by
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, Real.log_mul]
    · exact_mod_cast (show p ≠ 0 by omega)
    · exact_mod_cast (show q ≠ 0 by omega)
  rw [hlog a k ha hk, hlog b m hb hm, resPt, resPt]
  ring

/-- Rational samples are exactly the corresponding finite multiplicative diagonal. -/
theorem gramPacket_rational_sample (N L : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℂ)
    {a b : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hbL : b ≤ L) :
    EF.weilTest (gramPacket N L c) (gramPacket N L c) (Real.log a - Real.log b) =
      (packetMass N L : ℂ) * ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
        if a * k = b * m then c m * conj (c k) else 0 := by
  change EF.weilTest (fun u => ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
    c m * narrowBumpC (N * L) (u - resPt N m))
    (fun u => ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      c m * narrowBumpC (N * L) (u - resPt N m)) _ = _
  rw [weilTest_sum_translates (contDiff_narrowBumpC _).continuous
    (hasCompactSupport_narrowBumpC _), Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  obtain ⟨hm1, hmN⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hm
  obtain ⟨hk1, _⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk
  rw [rational_sample_shift N a b m k ha hb hm1 hk1]
  by_cases heq : a * k = b * m
  · rw [if_pos heq, heq, sub_self]
    change c m * conj (c k) * EF.weilTest
      (fun u => ((narrowBump (N * L) u : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (fun u => ((narrowBump (N * L) u : ℝ) : ℂ)) 0 = _
    rw [weilTest_self_zero_ofReal]
    unfold packetMass
    ring
  · rw [if_neg heq, packet_autocorrelation_zero (N * L)
      (log_gap (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith) heq)]
    simp

private def extendPacketCoeffs {N : ℕ} (c : PacketIndex N → ℂ) (m : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  if hm : m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N then c ⟨m, hm⟩ else 0

private theorem extendPacketCoeffs_apply {N : ℕ} (c : PacketIndex N → ℂ)
    (m : PacketIndex N) : extendPacketCoeffs c m = c m := by
  simp only [extendPacketCoeffs, dif_pos m.property]

private theorem gramPacket_rational_sample_subtype (N L : ℕ)
    (c : PacketIndex N → ℂ) {a b : ℕ}

/-- A nonzero Fourier mass has strictly positive primitive mass. -/
theorem primitiveMass_pos {a : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hs : tsupport f ⊆ Icc (-a) a)
    (hm : 0 < fourierMass f) : 0 < primitiveMass f := by
  have hp : 0 ≤ primitiveMass f := integral_nonneg fun τ => by positivity
  by_contra hn
  have hz : primitiveMass f = 0 := by linarith
  have h := quarter_bound hf hs (coercivityConst+archEnergy f/fourierMass f+1)
  dsimp [surrogate] at h
  rw [hz, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h
  have he : archEnergy f/fourierMass f*fourierMass f=archEnergy f :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ hm.ne'
  nlinarith

/-- Optimizing the restored estimate cancels the entire primitive penalty. -/
private theorem logarithmic_mass_ratio_bound_of_pos {a : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hs : tsupport f ⊆ Icc (-a) a)
    (hm : 0 < fourierMass f) :
    (log (fourierMass f/primitiveMass f)/4-coercivityConst)*fourierMass f ≤
      archEnergy f := by
  have hp := primitiveMass_pos hf hs hm
  have hx : exp (log (fourierMass f/primitiveMass f)/4)^4 =
      fourierMass f/primitiveMass f := by
    rw [← exp_nat_mul]
    norm_num
    rw [show 4*(log (fourierMass f/primitiveMass f)/4)=
      log (fourierMass f/primitiveMass f) by ring, exp_log (div_pos hm hp)]
  have h := quarter_bound hf hs (log (fourierMass f/primitiveMass f)/4)
  dsimp [surrogate] at h
  rw [hx] at h
  have he : (fourierMass f/primitiveMass f)/4*primitiveMass f=fourierMass f/4 := by
    field_simp [hp.ne']
  linarith

/-- The optimized bound also includes zero sources; no nonzero-mass premise remains. -/
theorem logarithmic_mass_ratio_bound {a : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hs : tsupport f ⊆ Icc (-a) a) :
    (log (fourierMass f/primitiveMass f)/4-coercivityConst)*fourierMass f ≤
      archEnergy f := by
  have hm : 0 ≤ fourierMass f := integral_nonneg fun τ => sq_nonneg _
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hm with hm | hm
  · exact logarithmic_mass_ratio_bound_of_pos hf hs hm
  · have hz : fourierMass f=0 := hm.symm
    have hp : primitiveMass f=0 := by
      have hlo : 0 ≤ primitiveMass f := integral_nonneg fun τ => by positivity
      have hhi := primitiveMass_le hf hs
      rw [hz, mul_zero] at hhi
      exact le_antisymm hhi hlo
    have h := quarter_bound hf hs 0
    simpa [surrogate, hz, hp] using h

/-- The physical/Fourier mass conversion keeps the literal factor `2*pi`. -/
theorem fourierMass_eq {a : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hs : tsupport f ⊆ Icc (-a) a) :
    fourierMass f=2*π*ExposingRayMass.mass f := by
  have h := integral_normSq_paperFT_mul_cos_eq hf hs 0
  simp only [mul_zero, cos_zero, mul_one, neg_zero, weilTest_self_zero,
    Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re] at h
  dsimp [fourierMass, ExposingRayMass.mass]
  rw [h]
  ring

/-- One exact matched family defeats all row-dependent choices of the former
primitive parameter, with any fixed box-tail slack. No energy-positivity premise. -/
theorem adaptive_surrogate_counterexample :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      N ≤ ⌊exp (2*(log N/2+C))⌋₊ ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : Fin m → ℝ) (f : Fin m → ℝ → ℂ) (α : Fin m → ℝ),
        (∀ i, a i ≤ log N/2+C) ∧ (∀ i, IsPolarTest (a i) (f i)) ∧
        (∀ i, 0 ≤ α i) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → 2*π*∑ i, α i*atomCoeff (f i) n=exposingWeightTrunc N n) ∧
        ∀ b : Fin m → ℝ, (∑ i, α i*surrogate (b i) (f i)) <
          archimedeanExposingThreshold-c*exposingTail N := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hfam⟩ := ExposingRayMass.mass_margin_counterexample
  refine ⟨C,hC,fun c => ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hfam (π/2) (by positivity) c] with N hN
  obtain ⟨hfloor,m,a,f,α,ha,hf,hα,hm,hE⟩ := hN
  refine ⟨hfloor,m,a,f,α,ha,hf,hα,hm,fun b => ?_⟩
  have hb : ∀ i, α i*surrogate (b i) (f i) ≤
      α i*archEnergy (f i)-(π/2)*(α i*ExposingRayMass.mass (f i)) := by
    intro i
    have h := quarter_bound (hf i).2.1 (hf i).2.2.1 (b i)
    rw [fourierMass_eq (hf i).2.1 (hf i).2.2.1] at h
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (hα i)
    nlinarith only [hh]
  have h := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) fun i _ => hb i
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum] at h
  exact h.trans_lt hE

# One-sided rational phase rigidity of the actual Weil source

The triangular rational resonance equations force the actual Dirichlet
quotient onto numerator powers. Its logarithmic derivative has the same
support, and full positivity excludes every nontrivial lacunary deviation.
The final alternative has only the specified Weil-positive source as premise;
no one-sided phase representation is asserted to follow from that source.
-/

open Complex
noncomputable section

theorem quantization_rigidity_of_oneSided_rational_phase {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) {u v : ℕ} (hv : 1 ≤ v) (hvu : v < u)
    (huv : u.Coprime v) {p : ℕ → ℂ}
    (hp : Summable fun k => ‖p k‖ * ((u : ℝ) / v) ^ k)
    (hphase : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
      cexp (((2 * Real.pi * quantizationResidualCumulative hW x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) =
        ∑' k : ℕ, p k * cexp (((2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log ((u : ℝ) / v) * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis := by
  have hu : 2 ≤ u := by omega
  obtain ⟨hp0, hrows⟩ := quantization_phase_rational_rows hW hv hvu huv hp hphase
  let c : ℕ → ℂ := fun k =>
    p k * (Real.exp ((2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log ((u : ℝ) / v)) / 4) : ℂ)
  have hc : c 0 ≠ 0 := by simpa [c] using hp0
  have hc0 : c 0 = p 0 := by simp [c]
  have hvdep := quantization_rational_rows_classification hu hv huv hc
    (a := dirichletExp (lamLog lam)) (by simpa only [c, hc0] using hrows)
  obtain ⟨b, hb1, hb, hba⟩ := quantization_exists_power_quotient hu
    (a := dirichletExp (lamLog lam)) dirichletExp_zero
    (dirichletExp_one (lamLog_zero lam) (lamLog_one lam)) hvdep
  have hcoef : WeilSingularArithmetic.forwardCoeff lam = dirichletExp (lamLog lam) := by
    unfold WeilSingularArithmetic.forwardCoeff
    congr 1
    funext n
    simp only [logZetaCoeff, lamLog]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hsupp := quantization_source_logarithmic_support hW hb1 hb
    (fun n => (hba n).trans (congrFun hcoef n).symm)
  have hΛ : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n := by
    apply eq_vonMangoldt_of_weilPositiveFull_of_threeHalves_lacunary hW
      (n := fun j => u ^ (j+1)) (by simpa using hu)
    · intro j
      rw [show j+1+1 = (j+1)+1 by rfl, pow_succ]
      nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (u^(j+1))]
    · intro n hn hnp
      apply hsupp n hn
      rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
      cases j with
      | zero => simp at hj; omega
      | succ j => exact hnp j hj
  refine ⟨hΛ, riemannHypothesis_iff_weilPositiveFull_vonMangoldt.mpr ?_⟩
  intro f hf hfc
  rw [weilFullFunctional_congr (lam' := lam) (fun n hn => (hΛ n hn).symm)]
  exact hW f hf hfc

theorem quantization_rigidity_or_no_oneSided_rational_phase {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ((∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis) ∨
      ∀ u v : ℕ, 1 ≤ v → v < u → u.Coprime v → ¬∃ p : ℕ → ℂ,
        (Summable fun k => ‖p k‖ * ((u : ℝ) / v) ^ k) ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
          cexp (((2 * Real.pi * quantizationResidualCumulative hW x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) =
            ∑' k : ℕ, p k * cexp (((2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log ((u : ℝ) / v) * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) := by
  by_cases hR : (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis
  · exact Or.inl hR
  · refine Or.inr (fun u v hv hvu huv => ?_)
    rintro ⟨p, hp, hphase⟩
    exact hR (quantization_rigidity_of_oneSided_rational_phase hW hv hvu huv hp hphase)

end RHTower.WeilSpectral

/-!
# Linear sampling of the zero-mass integer-null Weil space

The paper's prime-subset masks give surjective finite rational sampling maps on
the actual signed mixture space. Consecutive coprime labels supply arbitrarily
large real coordinate quotients, proving that this null space is infinite-dimensional.
Every finite sampler also admits a linear right inverse.
-/

open Complex Zeta23
noncomputable section
namespace RHTower.WeilWorkPBAP

open WeilOneSided

/-- Signed finite mixtures satisfying all integer constraints and zero autocorrelation mass. -/
def paperNullMassSpace : Submodule ℝ (WeilTestFn →₀ ℝ) :=
  LinearMap.ker defect ⊓ LinearMap.ker
    (Finsupp.linearCombination ℝ (fun f : WeilTestFn => EF.weilTest f.1 f.1 0))

@[simp] theorem mem_paperNullMassSpace (d : WeilTestFn →₀ ℝ) :
    d ∈ paperNullMassSpace ↔ defect d = 0 ∧ mixtureSample d 0 = 0 := Iff.rfl

/-- All primitive rational samples in one packet, as a real linear map on the native null space. -/
def paperPrimitiveSampler (N : ℕ) :
    paperNullMassSpace →ₗ[ℝ] (PaperPacketPrimitiveEdge N → ℂ) :=
  (LinearMap.pi fun r : PaperPacketPrimitiveEdge N =>
    Finsupp.linearCombination ℝ (fun f : WeilTestFn =>
      EF.weilTest f.1 f.1 (Real.log (r.1.1 : ℕ) - Real.log (r.1.2 : ℕ)))).comp
        paperNullMassSpace.subtype

@[simp] theorem paperPrimitiveSampler_apply (N : ℕ) (d : paperNullMassSpace)
    (r : PaperPacketPrimitiveEdge N) :
    paperPrimitiveSampler N d r =
      mixtureSample d.1 (Real.log (r.1.1 : ℕ) - Real.log (r.1.2 : ℕ)) := rfl

/-- The positive-pair construction realizes every finite complex observation vector. -/
theorem paperPrimitiveSampler_surjective (N : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (paperPrimitiveSampler N) := by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hm, hs⟩ := exists_integer_null_zero_mass_primitive_interpolant 0 z
  exact ⟨⟨d, hd, hm⟩, funext hs⟩

/-- Primitive observations admit linear lifts into the exact zero-mass integer-null space. -/
theorem exists_paperPrimitiveSampler_rightInverse (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ S : (PaperPacketPrimitiveEdge N → ℂ) →ₗ[ℝ] paperNullMassSpace,
      (paperPrimitiveSampler N).comp S = LinearMap.id :=
  (paperPrimitiveSampler N).exists_rightInverse_of_surjective
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (paperPrimitiveSampler_surjective N))

theorem rank_primitive_samples_le_nullMassSpace (N : ℕ) :
    Module.rank ℝ (PaperPacketPrimitiveEdge N → ℂ) ≤ Module.rank ℝ paperNullMassSpace :=
  (paperPrimitiveSampler N).rank_le_of_surjective (paperPrimitiveSampler_surjective N)

/-- Consecutive positive labels give arbitrarily many distinct primitive edges. -/
def paperConsecutiveEdge (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) : PaperPacketPrimitiveEdge (n + 2) :=
  ⟨(⟨(i : ℕ) + 2, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (by have := i.isLt; constructor <;> omega)⟩,
    ⟨(i : ℕ) + 3, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (by have := i.isLt; constructor <;> omega)⟩),
    by
      change 1 < (i : ℕ) + 2 ∧ (i : ℕ) + 2 < (i : ℕ) + 3 ∧
        Nat.Coprime ((i : ℕ) + 2) ((i : ℕ) + 3)
      refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      change Nat.Coprime ((i : ℕ) + 2) (((i : ℕ) + 2) + 1)
      simp⟩

theorem paperConsecutiveEdge_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (paperConsecutiveEdge n) := by
  intro i j h
  have hv := congrArg (fun r : PaperPacketPrimitiveEdge (n + 2) => (r.1.1 : ℕ)) h
  change (i : ℕ) + 2 = (j : ℕ) + 2 at hv
  apply Fin.ext
  omega

/-- Real samples on consecutive reduced ratios form an arbitrary finite coordinate quotient. -/
def paperConsecutiveSampler (n : ℕ) : paperNullMassSpace →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ) :=
  (LinearMap.pi fun i : Fin n => Complex.reCLM.toLinearMap.comp
    (Finsupp.linearCombination ℝ (fun f : WeilTestFn =>
      EF.weilTest f.1 f.1 (Real.log ((paperConsecutiveEdge n i).1.1 : ℕ) -
        Real.log ((paperConsecutiveEdge n i).1.2 : ℕ))))).comp paperNullMassSpace.subtype

@[simp] theorem paperConsecutiveSampler_apply (n : ℕ) (d : paperNullMassSpace) (i : Fin n) :
    paperConsecutiveSampler n d i =
      (mixtureSample d.1 (Real.log ((paperConsecutiveEdge n i).1.1 : ℕ) -
        Real.log ((paperConsecutiveEdge n i).1.2 : ℕ))).re := rfl

/-- Every real coordinate vector occurs while every integer defect and the mass stay zero. -/
theorem paperConsecutiveSampler_surjective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (paperConsecutiveSampler n) := by
  intro v
  let z : PaperPacketPrimitiveEdge (n + 2) → ℂ :=
